pōculum, pōculī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

cup or drinking vessel

Other words

  • pōculum ānsātum — cup with a handle

    also used · modern · Traupman 299

  • pōcillum, pōcillī n. — a small cup, of coffee or tea

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 71; Cato, Agr. 156; Liv. 10.42; Traupman 123; Traupman 299 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • pōcillum caffeārium

    a coffee cupTraupman 70

  • pōcillum caffeae (theae)

    a cup of coffee (tea)Traupman 71

  • Ita, pōcillum caffeae cum cremō.

    Yes, a cup of coffee with cream.Traupman 67

  • pōcillum theānum

    a teacupTraupman 391

See also glass, tea, coffee.
